steps.title: What is a Schema Registry?
steps.text: A schema registry provides centralized schema management for Surgewave. It defines message structure, validates data quality, and enables safe schema evolution over time.

steps.title: What is a Schema?
steps.text: A schema defines your data structure: field names and types, required vs optional fields, and validation rules. It acts as a contract between producers and consumers.

steps.title: Schema Registry Benefits
steps.text: Schemas provide data quality through validation, serve as shared contracts, enable safe evolution, and act as self-documenting data structures.

steps.title: Compatibility Modes
steps.text: Choose from backward (new reads old), forward (old reads new), full (both directions), or none (no checking) compatibility modes based on your evolution strategy.

steps.title: Hands-On Lessons
steps.text: Start with schema basics in 10.1, then learn JSON Schema in 10.2, versioning in 10.3, compatibility enforcement in 10.4, and practical integration in 10.5.
